column1: Market Context Note: The notable growth spikes in the technology and automotive-adjacent manufacturing sectors from 2024 to 2025 are primarily driven by stricter Scope 2 accounting protocols under the GHG Protocol and localized updates to regional I-REC issuing rules. Additionally, the broader market witnessed a substantial geographical shift as major voluntary corporate demand rapidly transitioned toward emerging solar and wind certificate issuance across Latin America and South/Southeast Asia.
